defect_review.prompt: Review this synthetic Python eligibility function. Line 1: def eligible(x): Line 2: return x > 18. Specification: age 18 or older is eligible. Return only JSON with exactly defect_line (integer line number) and fix (the corrected expression as a string). Do not return code fences.

structured_qa.prompt: Check synthetic publication rows. A valid row has a nonempty title and a positive integer pages. Rows: A title=Sample pages=12; B title='' pages=8; C title=Example pages=0. Return only JSON with exactly invalid_ids (IDs in input order) and valid_count (integer).
